shared_elements: horizontal registers or bands dividing the field
row of repeated similar motifs across the top
animals rendered in profile, including birds
justification: Both are tall upright carved slabs organised into horizontal registers, with a band of repeated, similarly sized motifs across the top and profile animals (birds included) occupying the field below. Beyond that generic scheme they differ radically: A is a weathered, sparsely populated relief with a few large stylised beasts and a snake, photographed in situ, while B is a crisp line drawing of a round-topped stela dominated by a rayed disc, human figures and dozens of dense lines of script.
